title: Data migration with migrate-transcripts.ts and the Cognito user re-link
description:
## Plan steps 8 and 9 (decision D5 first)
Per environment: migrate-transcripts.ts copy --dry-run, copy, latest-turns, gate close, delta, verify, gate open. Cognito users cannot be exported with passwords: new pool and re-link by Google email. Snapshots stay in S3. First get an owner-authorized read-only item count of legacy staging and production Messaging to decide whether migration is needed at all or those environments can start fresh like development.
## Acceptance
- The count is recorded; if migrating, verify reports no missing items and the gate is reopened.
- After the flip there is one reader (no dual readers).
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed.
right_now_summary: Nothing has been executed; the team awaits an owner-authorized item count before deciding whether to migrate.
